newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss newspaper ad pages drop 8.4 pct in February.
newsitem.headline: Swiss newspaper ad pages drop 8.4 pct in February.

text.p: Advertising pages in Swiss newspapers fell 8.4 percent in February compared with a year earlier, according to figures compiled by the WEMF media tracking agency. The drop was 6.4 percent in January. (pct change in pages vs year-ago)

The Association of Swiss Advertising Companies (VSW) said the figures tended to overstate the drop. It said a more useful comparison would use the number of pages per editions appearing, which helped reflect an industry consolidation last year. This system showed gains in practically every category in February, it said.
